title: NEBExpress MBP Fusion and Purification System
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfayjifw
materials: Lyse the cells by freeze-thaw followed by sonication.

steps.title: Subclone Gene of Interest
steps.instruction: Subclone the gene of interest into the pMAL-c6T vector.

steps.title: Grow Fusion Cells
steps.instruction: Grow cells containing the pMAL-c6T fusion plasmid in LB containing ampicillin and 0.2% glucose until they reach an A 600 of ~0.5.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Induce expression by adding IPTG to a final concentration of 0.3 millimolar (mM).

steps.title: Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Grow the cells for an additional period based on the chosen temperature:

steps.title: Harvest and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells and either freeze them immediately or resuspend them in column buffer (CB).

substeps.instruction: Use 25 ml column buffer (CB) per liter of culture for resuspension

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Clarify the lysate by centrifugation at 20000 rpm for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Dilute Crude Extract
steps.instruction: Dilute the supernatant (crude extract) by adding cold CB.

substeps.instruction: Add 125 mL cold CB for every 25 ml of crude extract

steps.title: Load Amylose Column
steps.instruction: Load the diluted crude extract onto a 15 ml amylose column.

steps.title: Wash Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with ≥ 12 column volumes of CB.

steps.title: Elute Fusion Protein
steps.instruction: Elute the fusion protein using CB containing 10 millimolar (mM) maltose.
